projects.name: Trackcrow
projects.description: Simplify your expense tracking effortlessly every day
projects.longDescription: TrackCrow is an intelligent expense tracking application that automatically extracts and categorizes transactions from SMS notifications, providing powerful insights to help you manage your finances effortlessly.
features: Automatic SMS extraction and transaction categorization
Smart dashboard with visual analytics and spending insights
AI-powered suggestions to optimize spending habits
Custom expense categories with manual entry options
Comprehensive data visualization through charts and graphs

projects.name: DotMd
projects.description: Designed to create and customize beautiful README files easily
projects.longDescription: DotMd is a powerful markdown editor designed to help developers create and customize beautiful README files with ease, featuring an intuitive drag-and-drop interface and live preview.
features: Drag-and-drop interface for easy section management
Customizable templates to jumpstart your documentation
Live preview with real-time Markdown rendering
Export to multiple formats: Markdown, HTML, or plain text
Full Markdown support with syntax highlighting

projects.name: Clipnote
projects.description: Your second brain for YouTube: notes, summaries, labels, and search seamlessly
projects.longDescription: Clipnote is a Chrome extension that transforms how you interact with YouTube content, allowing timestamped notes and AI-powered summaries while maintaining complete privacy through self-hosted storage.
features: Timestamped notes synchronized with video playback
AI-powered context-aware note generation
Interactive dashboard with full-text search across videos
One-click 5-point video summaries
Label system for organizing related content
Self-hosted backend for complete data privacy

projects.name: Wavetalk
projects.description: Real-time chat application for seamless and secure conversations
projects.longDescription: WaveTalk is a real-time communication platform combining text chat and peer-to-peer video capabilities, built with WebSocket and WebRTC technology for seamless conversations.
features: Real-time messaging with WebSocket technology
Peer-to-peer video chat capabilities
Room creation and joining with custom codes
User authentication for secure access
Clean, intuitive interface for easy navigation

projects.name: Ticket-Show
projects.description: Web App to browse and book movie tickets easily
projects.longDescription: Ticket-Show is a comprehensive theater booking platform with separate user and admin dashboards, featuring show management, analytics, and automated email reminders.
features: Browse and search available shows across multiple theaters
Admin dashboard with full CRUD operations for theaters and shows
Visual analytics and charts for booking insights
CSV export for data analysis
Daily booking reminders and monthly entertainment reports via email
RESTful API with authentication

projects.name: MoM-Bot
projects.description: A Discord bot that generates meeting minutes from voice channels
projects.longDescription: MoM-Bot is an intelligent Discord bot that automatically transcribes voice channel conversations and generates AI-powered meeting summaries, eliminating manual note-taking.
features: Live voice transcription using AssemblyAI streaming API
AI-generated bullet-point summaries with Google Gemini
Automatic posting of summaries to designated channels
Local transcript storage with metadata
TypeScript for full type safety

projects.name: Grademate
projects.description: Grade calculator for IITM BS Data Science and Applications courses
projects.longDescription: GradeMate is a specialized grade calculator for IITM BS Data Science students, providing instant and accurate grade calculations based on the latest curriculum weightings.
features: Pre-defined course selection for IITM BS program
Custom course configuration support
Input scores for assignments, quizzes, exams, and projects
Instant grade calculation with accurate weightings
Clean, intuitive interface for easy navigation

projects.name: Dinohop
projects.description: Endless runner game built Kaboom.js where the dinosaur jumps over obstacles to score points
projects.longDescription: Dinohop is a browser-based endless runner game where players control a dinosaur jumping over obstacles, with progressively increasing difficulty and responsive controls.
features: Responsive controls: spacebar, click, or tap
Progressively increasing difficulty and speed
Score tracking and high score challenges
Clean, simple UI built with Kaboom.js
Lightweight and runs smoothly in any browser
